The '''Sundari shipping docks''' were located just outside the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] capital city [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] and was where cargo ships docked on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to load and unload [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]].
